atoms.sound: My favourite book is about a disappearance that takes place in a tall block of flats. A character called Alex and his loyal dog Lucky have to follow bewildering clues around the building to discover why one of the neighbours disappeared.

atoms.text: The story begins in a tall block of flats.
Alex realizes that one of his neighbours has disappeared.
He searches the building, following a series of confusing clues.
He discovers the reason behind the neighbour’s disappearance.

atoms.sound: My favourite book tells the real tale of Milly Brant, a hard-working postwoman from a small mountain town. It follows the story of how once, during a heavy winter storm, she helped the town by getting important messages through safely.

atoms.text: The story begins with Milly Brant, a postwoman in a small town.
One winter, a powerful snowstorm hits the town.
Despite the danger, Milly safely delivers important messages.
Thanks to her bravery, the town makes it through the storm.

atoms.sound: I really enjoyed the fantasy book we read in our English classes this month! Who was your favourite character?
Definitely the dragon rider! I thought she was really brave and funny. Which character was your favourite, Reece?
Oh, I liked the old wise librarian the most, Noor. She always knew just the right spell or piece of advice to help everyone.
